name: ai-digital-twin-portfolio
description: AI digital twin portfolio: grounded answering with citations and abstention, Angular 20.3 + NestJS 11 + pgvector + local Ollama.

scripts.build:libs: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:core
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:core && npm run --workspace @twin/api test -- --passWithNoTests && npm run test:web
scripts.db:migrate: for f in apps/api/migrations/*.sql; do docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U twin -d twin -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.build:pages: npm run bundle && npm run --workspace @twin/web build -- --base-href /ai-digital-twin-portfolio/
